name: Terminal Control
description: Bounded A2A tools for listing terminal sessions, reading output ranges, globbing terminal events, and attach-gated input forwarding.

tuiControl.summary: Rules for driving interactive TUI sessions (codex/claude) via send-input and send-key.

charByCharTyping.rule: TUI input must be typed char-by-char (~12ms/char). Bulk-writing a prompt and pressing Enter leaves the text unsubmitted.
charByCharTyping.note: The backend send-input/envelope paths type char-by-char automatically; agents do not do it manually, but must not rely on bulk-paste behavior.

sendKey.usage: Public primitive for TUI navigation (menus, pickers, model switcher).

modelPicker.recipe: send-input "/model", then send-key up/down to navigate, send-key enter to confirm, send-key esc to cancel.

preferredModelSwitch.why: Non-interactive alternative: writes the project-scoped runtime config (e.g. .codex/config.toml model field), then restartRequired.

warnings: A lone \r can be interpreted as interrupt in some TUI states.
